question: After Indian Hockey Federation was dismissed in 2008 by IOA, _________ was formed.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hockey India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Hockey India was formed in 2009, following the dismissal of the Indian Hockey Federation by the Indian Olympic Association (IOA) in 2008.
 
• Hockey India is the governing body for field hockey in India, responsible for the administration of both men’s and women’s hockey.
 
• It is recognized by the International Hockey Federation (FIH) as the national association for field hockey in India.
 
• Hockey India organizes national championships and oversees the development of the sport across the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Hockey Federation (IHF):**

 
 
• Formed in 1925, the IHF was the original governing body for field hockey in India before its dismissal in 2008.
 
• The IHF was responsible for the administration and promotion of field hockey in India during its tenure.
 
 
 
• **Indian Olympic Association (IOA):**
 
 
• The IOA is the body responsible for selecting athletes to represent India at the Olympic Games, Asian Games, and other international athletic meets.
 
• It played a key role in the formation of Hockey India after the dismissal of the IHF.
 
 
 
• **International Hockey Federation (FIH):**
 
 
• The FIH is the international governing body for field hockey and indoor field hockey.
 
• It works to promote the sport globally and organizes major international tournaments like the Hockey World Cup.
 
 
 
• **National Championships:**
 
 
• These are domestic field hockey tournaments organized by Hockey India to promote the sport at various levels.
 
• They include competitions like the Hockey India League (HIL) and various age-group championships.
